note: Directory names each sibling checkout can carry, newest first, plus the env vars that override the guess. THE source of truth for the ecosystem's rename history - lib/repos.mjs resolves from it, and abap2UI5/vscode-extension snapshots it into src/data/repo-dirs.json. Add a name here when a repository is renamed; never keep a second list somewhere else. The `server` entry is this repository itself: it resolves nothing for its own sake, but the extension looks for a local checkout of it by directory name and would miss one carrying the previous name.
probes: `probe` is the file that proves a candidate directory is a checkout of that repository. Where that file alone cannot tell two repositories apart, `identify` narrows it: each entry names a JSON file, a top-level key and what the value has to be (`equals`, compared case-insensitively) or has to contain (`hasKeys`). A check whose file is absent, unparseable, or missing that key is SKIPPED rather than failed - an older checkout from before the file existed must keep resolving, which is the whole reason `probe` is the cheap existence test it is. `required: true` reverses that for a check reading the probe file itself, where a missing key is proof rather than ignorance.

corpus.why: The corpus: the UI5 demo kit rebuilt control by control, port by port. e2e-build, the capability map, the scope gate, the deploy sandbox and the @openui5 packages the render/boot path serves. (No count here on purpose - each repository states its own in its generated SAMPLES.md / STATUS.md, and a number copied into a description is one nothing re-measures.)

samples.why: The pattern catalogue: which PATTERN has somebody already built. A different repository from the corpus on purpose - that one answers which CONTROL can be expressed.

samplesStack.why: The third catalogue: apps that need something from the STACK - an OData service, a RAP behavior definition, an APC channel, the Fiori launchpad. They cannot run on a bare abap2UI5 install.

appTemplate.why: The starter project: both gate configs, the CI workflow, the abapGit metadata and one working app class.

docs.why: The documentation site: the cookbook, the setup and configuration chapters, the advanced guides. docs_search reads its markdown sources; the published site serves the same pages rendered.

viewCheck.why: The abap2UI5 linter: the property and render gates, imported through its package.json exports map.

server.why: This server. Listed so a consumer looking for a local checkout of it - the VS Code extension does, before falling back to npx - finds one under either name.
